window5_to6_ramp.note: A solid ramp spans the complete 42.754 mm shared window height. Its 8.640 mm horizontal run rises 2.500 mm at 16.14 degrees from window 5 on the left to window 6 on the right. The photo registration maps increasing model X to the right; the earlier reversed profile was incorrect. The high endpoint is on window 6's left edge, preserving its 69 mm width; the ramp removes the old divider shoulder above the incline. Mesh cross-sections and material/void probes check the monotone face at three positions along its length. The 8.5 mm cube sweep is CAD-only.

top_surface_followup.intent: Two 0.10 mm top-skin layers and top ironing provide a smoother surface candidate. Rotating aligned raster lines to the shorter panel axis reduces continuous line length; physical surface and clarity remain unverified.

settings_changed_after_review: Increase transparent-front top skin from one to two 0.10 mm layers while retaining top ironing.
Rotate the 100% aligned single-direction infill and solid-surface raster to 90 degrees, along the panel's shorter axis.
Raise only transparent filament slot 1 nozzle temperature from 220 C to 230 C as a one-variable test candidate; retain the calibrated 0.98 flow.
Assign the transparent front to ACE/filament slot 1; keep global Textured PEI, select Cool Plate only for plate 3, and use 35 C for slot 1 Cool Plate first/normal bed temperatures.

Reduce transparent-front object initial-layer wall/sparse speed from 40 to 20 mm/s; with zero bottom-shell layers, first-layer fill follows this sparse-infill speed, so the separate 60 mm/s solid-infill setting is unchanged and inapplicable. Retain first-layer flow, line width and print sequence.
not_adopted: Simplify3D-specific outline/solid underspeed percentages were not transferred; effective per-feature speed remains unverified
A 0.30 mm layer / 240 C / 100% fan / 0.75 flow optimum reported for a different PLA on Prusa MK4 1 mm coupons; not transferred to this Kobra S1 fit-critical 2.5 mm panel.

A blanket +5% flow increase: the current 0.98 ratio would become 1.029, but there is no spool-specific calibration showing under-extrusion; extra material can build up on top surfaces and compromise the 8.64 mm openings with only 0.14 mm nominal cube clearance.
PETG temperatures, wider lines, 1.01 flow, and PETG drying schedules are not transferable to the unidentified transparent PLA spool

physical_fit: The 3.0 mm sockets / 2.6 mm pins are inherited from the previously coupon-tested variant. The new 2.5 mm front, shortened pins, laminate-edge registration, resized windows and complete tableau fit have not been physically tested. The user asked to preserve the existing Z stack; laminate thickness/compression remains unverified. The transparent PLA profile has no physical test print on this 0.10 mm / 20 mm/s revision.
